import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long BIGNUM = 1000000000L;
    static final long MAX_SIZE = 5007;
    
    static class TransportEdge {
        int start;
        int end;
        long quota;
        long fee;
        long routed;
        
        TransportEdge(int s, int e, long q, long f) {
            start = s;
            end = e;
            quota = q;
            fee = f;
            routed = 0;
        }
    }
    
    static List<TransportEdge> full_edge_list = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] d_ary = new long[(int)MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] phi_vec = new long[(int)MAX_SIZE];
    static List<Integer>[] neighbor_map = new List[(int)MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] pred_edge = new int[(int)MAX_SIZE];
    
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            neighbor_map[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
    
    static void bridge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        neighbor_map[u].add(full_edge_list.size());
        full_edge_list.add(new TransportEdge(u, v, cap, cost));
        neighbor_map[v].add(full_edge_list.size());
        full_edge_list.add(new TransportEdge(v, u, 0, -cost));
    }
    
    static void setup_potential(int source, int nodes) {
        Arrays.fill(phi_vec, BIGNUM);
        phi_vec[source] = 0;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < nodes; ++iter) {
            for (int i = 0; i < full_edge_list.size(); ++i) {
                TransportEdge e = full_edge_list.get(i);
                if (e.quota == e.routed) continue;
                if (phi_vec[e.start] == BIGNUM) continue;
                phi_vec[e.end] = Math.min(phi_vec[e.end], phi_vec[e.start] + e.fee);
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void relax_paths(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(d_ary, BIGNUM);
        d_ary[source] = 0;
        TreeSet<Pair> heap = new TreeSet<>((a, b) -> {
            if (a.first != b.first) return Long.compare(a.first, b.first);
            return Integer.compare(a.second, b.second);
        });
        heap.add(new Pair(0, source));
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            Pair top = heap.first();
            heap.remove(top);
            long cur = top.first;
            int v = top.second;
            for (int eid : neighbor_map[v]) {
                TransportEdge e = full_edge_list.get(eid);
                if (e.quota == e.routed) continue;
                int to = e.end;
                long wgt = e.fee + phi_vec[v] - phi_vec[to];
                if (d_ary[v] + wgt < d_ary[to]) {
                    heap.remove(new Pair(d_ary[to], to));
                    d_ary[to] = d_ary[v] + wgt;
                    pred_edge[to] = eid;
                    heap.add(new Pair(d_ary[to], to));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long f, int s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }
    
    static class Result {
        long cost;
        long flow;
        Result(long c, long f) {
            cost = c;
            flow = f;
        }
    }
    
    static Result min_cost_flow(int src, int dst) {
        setup_potential(src, 50);
        relax_paths(src);
        long flow_val = 0, cost_val = 0;
        while (d_ary[dst] != BIGNUM) {
            long flow_amt = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            long seg_fee = 0;
            for (int cur = dst; cur != src; ) {
                int eid = pred_edge[cur];
                flow_amt = Math.min(flow_amt, full_edge_list.get(eid).quota - full_edge_list.get(eid).routed);
                seg_fee += full_edge_list.get(eid).fee;
                cur = full_edge_list.get(eid).start;
            }
            flow_val += flow_amt;
            cost_val += flow_amt * seg_fee;
            for (int cur = dst; cur != src; ) {
                int eid = pred_edge[cur];
                full_edge_list.get(eid).routed += flow_amt;
                full_edge_list.get(eid ^ 1).routed -= flow_amt;
                cur = full_edge_list.get(eid).start;
            }
            relax_paths(src);
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) phi_vec[i] = d_ary[i];
        }
        return new Result(cost_val, flow_val);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int[] needs = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            needs[--x]++;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            bridge(5000, i, needs[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int round = 0; round < m; ++round) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int lvl = 0; lvl < 99; ++lvl) {
                long fee = d;
                for (int rep = 0; rep < 50; ++rep) {
                    bridge(u + lvl * 50, v + (lvl + 1) * 50, 1, fee);
                    bridge(v + lvl * 50, u + (lvl + 1) * 50, 1, fee);
                    fee += 2 * d;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int lvl = 0; lvl <= 99; ++lvl) {
            bridge(lvl * 50, 5001, Long.MAX_VALUE, c * lvl);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int lvl = 0; lvl < 99; ++lvl) {
                bridge(i + lvl * 50, i + (lvl + 1) * 50, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }
        
        Result result = min_cost_flow(5000, 5001);
        assert result.flow == k;
        System.out.println(result.cost);
    }
}
